name: Tachibana Mikoto
source:
Mikoto is a third year high school student in the same class as Mitsuki. She has an individual route which can only be unlocked after you have cleared all the other routes.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Akane_Iro_ni_Somaru_Saka]Wikipedia[/url].]
